changes.text: The chart is one tab stop: boxes use a roving `tabindex`, and the arrow keys, Home and End move focus between them.
Boxes are `role="img"` instead of `role="button"` (they have no action), and the pointer cursor is gone.
The tooltip is `aria-hidden="true"` (was `role="status"`) and closes on Escape, whether hover or focus opened it.
Each box's `aria-label` ends with the whisker ends (`min` and `max`), formatted with `yFormat`; before, they were only in the tooltip.

Default box colours come from the shared `CHART_PALETTE`, which reads the palette slots `--ss-accent`, `--ss-blue`, `--ss-magenta`, `--ss-cyan`, `--ss-yellow` and `--ss-green` (was `--ss-primary`, `--ss-purple` and `--ss-lime` for the first, third and sixth), so a custom palette recolours the boxes.

New component: a box-and-whisker distribution chart (quartiles with Tukey whiskers), one box per entry in `groups`, with an optional overlay of every value as a jittered dot (`showPoints`) and a tooltip on hover or focus.
